about_the_game:
About This Application

Build heroes for the Path of the Herald game system—fast.
The Path of the Herald: Character Creator is a desktop tool that lets you create characters in minutes, keep their sheets handy during play, and handle advancement with a single click. It’s lightweight, works entirely offline, and stores your characters locally so you’re always in control.

Key Features

  • Character creation & management – Create, save, load, and delete characters.

  • Full character sheet viewer – Keep everything you need visible during play.

  • Summaries at a glance – View Attributes, Skills, Maneuvers, and Spells in quick-reference panels.

  • HP tools – Adjust HP and Temp HP right from the sheet.

  • Train & level up workflow – Mark skills, maneuvers, and spells to train; use Long Rest to resolve advancement rolls.

  • Long Rest button – Restores some HP, clears Temp HP, and runs your training checks automatically.

  • Offline-first – No account or internet required. Characters are stored locally on your PC.

Saves are kept in your Windows user profile (typically %APPDATA%\Path of the Herald Character Creator\characters).

Who It’s For

  • Players and GMs who want a fast, reliable way to prep characters for the Path of the Herald game system.

  • Actual-play streamers and tabletop groups who prefer a clean, distraction-free character sheet on a second monitor or laptop.

  • Eventually, be able to port your saved characters from the app into Path of the Herald games.

Roadmap (free updates planned)

  • In-app rulebook reference

  • Enemy stat blocks & abilities viewer

  • Quality-of-life improvements and balance updates

  • Ability to Port Characters from the App to Path of the Herald Games

Platform

  • Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

  • Keyboard & mouse

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 / AMD equivalent)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • Additional Notes: Saves stored at "%APPDATA%\Path of the Herald Character Creator\characters". 64-bit OS required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz (Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD 620 / AMD Vega 8) or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • Additional Notes: Works offline. No admin rights required.
